Three distinct EQ voicings: • BOOST OFF: Sinister, hard-hitting tones ideal for rhythm parts. • LO BOOST: Takes things into 80's territory with scooped mids. • HI BOOST: Devastating, razor sharp tone with blistering highs, ideal for darker amps and cutting through the heaviest rhythm sections.
